title: Virtual Galaxy Infotech Limited (VGIL) - Overview
subtitle: Leading IT Solutions Provider & Financial Enterprise Software Pioneer
summary: Virtual Galaxy Infotech Limited (VGIL), incorporated in 1997, is a premier banking and financial technology enterprise headquartered in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. VGIL is officially listed on NSE India after an IPO that attracted ₹14,440 Cr in bids.
content: Virtual Galaxy Infotech Limited (VGIL) is an Indian information technology company incorporated in 1997 (CIN: L93000MH1997PLC110645). The company specializes in Core Banking Solutions (CBS E-Banker), ERP solutions, cloud computing, cyber security, digital lending, and IT infrastructure. VGIL operates its flagship Software Development Centre at MIHAN SEZ in Nagpur, Maharashtra. Key Achievements & Metrics: - Total banks served: 200+ financial institutions and banks across India and internationally. - Transactions processed: Over 30 Billion+ cumulative transactions. - Accounts managed: 10 Million+ accounts powered by VGIL systems. - Average transaction processing time: 10 milliseconds with 99.9% uptime SLA. - Stock exchange listing: Listed on the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE India) following a ₹93.29 Cr IPO that received bids worth ₹14,440 Cr. - International footprint: Landmark mandates including Botswana Development Corporation and global contracts exceeding $1.1 Million. - Recognitions: Sardar Patel Unity Award for Leading IT Solutions Provider of the Year.

title: What is Enterprise Resource Planning and its Importance?
subtitle: Blog
summary: It has been measured that businesses and industries are turning more and more towards installing an ERP system. It is proving a beneficial decision for any organization as it becomes easier to manage the various aspects of the working field with ease.
content: What is Enterprise Resource Planning and its Importance?. It has been measured that businesses and industries are turning more and more towards installing an ERP system. It is proving a beneficial decision for any organization as it becomes easier to manage the various aspects of the working field with ease. ERP system is an integrated system that manages various aspects of business, saves cost and time. It allows any type of business to keep track of different sections such as human resources, production and stock keeping, financial management, supply chain management, etc. It is a central hub for an end to end workflow and data. It collects an organization's shared data from multiple sources and eliminates data duplication. In today's advanced technology, such systems are considered essential for managing businesses of all sizes and in all industries.

title: Top 5 Advantages of Implementing an ERP System
subtitle: Blog
summary: Implementing an ERP system offers numerous benefits that can transform how your business operates, from improved efficiency to better data-driven insights.
content: Top 5 Advantages of Implementing an ERP System. Implementing an ERP system offers numerous benefits that can transform how your business operates, from improved efficiency to better data-driven insights. 1. Improved Efficiency: "Streamline" operations and automate repetitive tasks. 2. Real-time Data: "Access" accurate information across all departments instantaneously. 3. Better Collaboration: "Break" down silos and improve communication between teams. 4. Scalability: "Easily" adapt the system as your business grows. 5. Cost Savings: "Reduce" operational costs through better resource management.

title: What is a Virtual Private Network?
subtitle: Blog
summary: In an era of increasing digital threats, understanding how a VPN protects your corporate data is more critical than ever.
content: What is a Virtual Private Network?. In an era of increasing digital threats, understanding how a VPN protects your corporate data is more critical than ever. A Virtual Private Network (VPN) creates a secure, encrypted connection between your device and the internet. For businesses, this means employees can securely access corporate servers from any location without risking data leaks or unauthorized access. It acts as a secure tunnel for your digital communications.

title: What Is Core Banking Solution For Banks?
subtitle: Blog
summary: Core Banking Solutions (CBS) are the heart of modern financial institutions, enabling seamless transactions and centralized management.
content: What Is Core Banking Solution For Banks?. Core Banking Solutions (CBS) are the heart of modern financial institutions, enabling seamless transactions and centralized management. CBS allows banks to centralize their operations, providing a single view of the customer across all branches. This leads to faster transaction processing, improved customer service, and better compliance with financial regulations. It is the technological backbone that powers modern day banking.

title: How AI-Based Banking is Reshaping the Core Banking Landscape
subtitle: Blog
summary: Artificial Intelligence is no longer just a buzzword; it is actively transforming how banks interact with customers and manage risk.
content: How AI-Based Banking is Reshaping the Core Banking Landscape. Artificial Intelligence is no longer just a buzzword; it is actively transforming how banks interact with customers and manage risk. From AI-powered chatbots to advanced fraud detection algorithms, AI is making banking more personalized and secure. It helps institutions analyze vast amounts of data to predict market trends and offer tailored financial products to their customers, reshaping the entire landscape of financial services.

title: Strengthening Banking Security with a Centralized Cybersecurity Management Platform
subtitle: Blog
summary: A centralized approach to cybersecurity is the only way to stay ahead of sophisticated modern financial threats.
content: Strengthening Banking Security with a Centralized Cybersecurity Management Platform. A centralized approach to cybersecurity is the only way to stay ahead of sophisticated modern financial threats. Centralized cybersecurity platforms provide a unified view of all potential threats across the banking network. By integrating various security protocols into a single management interface, banks can respond faster to incidents and ensure that every layer of their digital infrastructure is protected against evolving cyber threats.
